trechos: Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG)(NASDAQ:GOOGL) stock is down 32% from the all-time high it hit this summer amid a sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks.
The Google parent expects capital expenditures of $195 billion to $205 billion in 2026, with even more spending planned for next year.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
Google's advertising machine keeps delivering Alphabet generated $127.6 billion in revenue during the third quarter, up 25% from a year ago.
Much of that comes directly from Google's formidable advertising business, which generated $82 billion in quarterly revenue, up 11% from a year ago.
Google Search alone contributed $63.3 billion, up 12%.
Google services, which includes advertising and subscriptions, generated $39.2 billion in operating income during the quarter.

itens.titulo: Como fica o Bradesco sem Trabuco
itens.descricao: Como fica o Bradesco sem Trabuco Brazil Journal
trechos: O conselho de administração do Bradesco se reúne com o comitê executivo do banco toda quinta, das 9h até por volta das 17h, com uma pausa para o almoço.
Mais tarde, soube-se que embarcou num dos Praetor 500 do banco rumo a Brasília.
Na parte da tarde, “estava difícil se concentrar, porque todos queriam saber se ele iria mesmo para o governo,” um membro do comitê executivo disse ao Brazil Journal.

Uma regra criada na época de Amador Aguiar determina que conselheiros e diretores que saem do Bradesco precisam vender as ações que detêm na BBD Participações, a holding que detém cerca de 5% do capital votante do banco de forma indireta.
“As ações de quem sai não vão para a família, por exemplo,” disse outro executivo da instituição.

“O objetivo é evitar ter donos que não estejam no dia a dia.” O Bradesco é controlado por três holdings – a Cidade de Deus (a principal, com cerca de 47% do capital votante), a Fundação Bradesco (com 17%) e a NCF Participações (com 8,5%).
A família Aguiar também integra o bloco de controle, por meio de uma participação de 16,6% na Cidade de Deus.
O estatuto do banco prevê uma idade-limite de 75 anos para conselheiros – a idade que Trabuco acaba de completar em 6 de outubro.

itens.titulo: Treasury yields are higher as investors look ahead to payroll data
itens.descricao: Treasury yields are higher as investors look ahead to payroll data CNBC
trechos: The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was up more than 8 basis points at 4.93%.
The yield on the 2-year Treasury note, which typically moves in line with short-term Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, was up more than 6 basis points at 4.699%.
The longer-dated 30-year Treasury yield, which tends to track geopolitical events, rose more than 8 basis points to 5.32%.
One basis point equals 0.01%, or 1/100th of 1%, and yields and prices move inversely to one another.
The report is expected to show 90,000 jobs added in the month compared to 165,000 in October, while unemployment is expected to hold steady at 4.1%, according to economists polled by FactSet.
"November's job growth should be solid after a robust gain in October," Evercore ISI's Stan Shipley wrote in a Friday note.
The firm projects payroll growth of 105,000, with the unemployment likely being unchanged at 4.1%.
"The wild card is seasonal hiring.

itens.titulo: China stocks surge most in two years as Beijing vows stronger market support
itens.descricao: China stocks surge most in two years as Beijing vows stronger market support Yahoo Finance
trechos: A bigger role for the "national team" of state investors is also the latest sign of authorities stepping into markets to shore up bets on the AI infrastructure buildout.

The benchmark Shanghai Composite Index ended 3.7% up and the blue-chip CSI300 index was 4.2% higher at the close, both notching their biggest daily gains since October 2024 when China rolled out massive stimulus to revive the market.
China's tech-focused STAR 50 Index surged 15% for its biggest one-day jump in two years, while a sub-index tracking semiconductors soared 19%, marking its biggest single-day gain ‌on record.
The rally also spread to Hong Kong, where the Hang Seng Index gained 2.1% while the Hang Seng Tech Index jumped more than 6%.
"It's a shot in the arm for markets," said Kenny Ng, a strategist at Everbright Securities International in Hong Kong.
"Sentiment has been downbeat for so long.
"Giving this message from the very top level ...

"There's probably this awareness that AI is strategically, economically and financially very important, and they don't want to see a big fallout in this space." The Chinese yuan ‌also gained against the dollar and is near its firmest level for four years.
